# Alpha
> The one placeholder concept the clean fixture is built around.

## What it is
A minimal concept page that follows the template in [[SCHEMA]] exactly: an H1,
a one-line definition, and the four required sections below.

## How we use it (project-specific!)
As the reference shape for a conformant concept page. Checks that fire on this
page are checks with a bug, not a wiki with a problem.
